keyword.createNote.description: Call to action that opens the note template of the glossary for a keyword.

keyword.factFiles.description: Label of the number of files a keyword appears in, in the panel of its page.

keyword.factOccurrences.description: Label of the number of occurrences of a keyword, in the panel of its page.

keyword.factSpaces.description: Label of the spaces a keyword appears in, in the panel of its page.

keyword.filesSummary.description: Sentence under the passages heading of a keyword page, counting the files they come from.

keyword.maybeSame.description: Heading of the panel block listing the expressions of a similar form.

keyword.noDefinition.description: Mark on the line under the title of a keyword page, saying that no note defines the word.

keyword.noProperty.defaultMessage: No declared property: there is no file for this word.
keyword.noProperty.description: Note under the counts of a keyword page, saying why it has no properties block.

keyword.noteWritten.defaultMessage: A note now defines this expression:
keyword.noteWritten.description: Text of the page that forwards a former keyword address to the note written since.

keyword.noticeDetail.defaultMessage: This page is built from those passages alone. If someone creates the note in the glossary, its text will take its place here and the rest of the page will not change.
keyword.noticeDetail.description: Second part of the notice of a keyword page, saying what the page is built from and what happens when a note is written.

keyword.noticeLead.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Nobody has written a definition, but # passage uses this word.} other {Nobody has written a definition, but # passages use this word.}}
keyword.noticeLead.description: First sentence of the notice of a keyword page, with the number of passages that use the word.

keyword.occurrences.description: Number of occurrences of a keyword across the corpus.

keyword.otherPassages.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# other passage} other {# other passages}}
keyword.otherPassages.description: Line under the two passages in view of a page on a keyword page, which unfolds the other passages of that page.

keyword.pageAt.description: Position of a passage read from a converted document, given by its page number.

keyword.passagesTitle.description: Heading of the passages of a keyword page.

keyword.relatedNote.defaultMessage: Ordered by number of passages. None is “cited”: this word has no note to carry links.
keyword.relatedNote.description: Note under the related pages of a keyword page, saying how they are ordered and why none is cited.

keyword.showOtherFiles.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Show the other file} other {Show the # other files}}
keyword.showOtherFiles.description: Disclosure under the six pages in view of a keyword page, which shows the passages of the other files.

keyword.similarLead.defaultMessage: Expressions close in form and context. A lead, not a claim.
keyword.similarLead.description: Note under the expressions of a similar form, worded so as to assert no relation.

keyword.slideAt.description: Position of a passage read from a slide deck, given by its slide number.

keyword.terms.description: Middle step of the breadcrumb of a keyword page, between the space and the word.

keyword.undefinedExpression.description: Notice that a keyword has no note of its own yet.

keyword.usedSince.description: Line under the title of a keyword page, giving the month of the oldest file that uses the word.

keyword.whatWeKnow.description: Heading of the panel block giving the counts of a keyword.
